questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Kangaroo Travel Agency

Potential Traveler

It’s time to travel!!!

November 3rd, 10:05 A.M.
 

We do Austrailia because we know Austrailia. Now it’s time to talk to the Australia specialist and book your Christmas and New Year’s holidays. Also, we’re offering special deals to Sydney, Melbourne, and many more tourist attractions in Austrailia. Call 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Please visit our Web site www.kangaroo.co.au. We hope to hear from you soon!

 
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a customer. In your e-mail, ask TWO questions about the travel packages and make ONE request.
questions.model_answer:
To Kangaroo Travel Agency: Lời chào
Thank you for your e-mail. I currently need to book a New Year’s holiday. The reason why I am writing to you is that I have been dreaming of visiting Australia and seeing the great natural landscapes over there. Also, I will have to attend my best friend’s wedding at the end of this year in Sydney. Actually, I have a few questions about your special deals. Is your tour program fixable enough to adjust the itinerary to one’s travel schedule (câu hỏi 1)? Are the all travel expenses included in the total payment (câu hỏi 2)? As I mentioned above, I’d like to see the natural landscapes in Austrailia as well, so please send me a brochure to help me learn more about sightseeing opportunities in Australia (yêu cầu). - Câu hỏi 1: Gói tour của bạn có linh hoạt để điều chỉnh theo lịch trình du lịch của một người được không? - Câu hỏi 2: Tất cả chi phí du lịch đã bao gồm trong tổng chi phí chưa? - Yêu cầu: Hãy gửi cho tôi tài liệu để tôi biết thêm về các nơi tham quan ở Úc.
I hope to hear you soon. Regards, Paul Smith Ký tên

questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Sandra Smith

White Appliances

Unsatisdactory Service

March 17th, 2:10 P.M.
 

White Appliances:

 

I’m writing to complain about the unsatisfactory service I received at your store. Two weeks ago, I purchased a newly launched model of washing machine. But, I found when I unpacked it that it had been damaged on the right side of the door. Also, when I was doing my laundry it automatically stopped and I couldn’t get it to start again. So, I tried to call the repair center over 5 times, but I still haven’t received any repair service. I think this is not a good way to treat customers. Please write back soon and let’s discuss this matter.

 
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a worker at White Appliances. In your e-mail, give at least ONE explanation and make TWO compensations.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Ms. Smith, Lời chào
I’ve just received your e-mail of March 17th concerning your problem. You were right to let us know about the unsatisfactory service you experienced. Your annoyance is perfectly understandable. However, we hope you will also try to see our point of view. You phoned our service department on Friday, March 9. The clerk handing your complaint arranged for a repairman to come to your home. However, upon arrival, the repairman found no one at home, and was not able to carry out the work until a new appointment had been made (giải thích). We apologize for failing to inform you in time. I’ve been informed by my manager that you’ll receive a voucher valued at $35 toward your next purchase at our store (đền bù 1). Also, we will not be charging you for the repairs to your washing machine (đền bù 2). Please let me know if I can be of any further assistance.   - Giải thích: Có một người sửa chữa đã đến nhà bạn nhưng không có ai ở đó cả và không thể sửa cho đến khi có một cuộc hẹn mới. - Đền bù 1: Bạn sẽ được nhận 1 voucer $35 cho lần mua tiếp theo. - Đền bù 2: Chúng tôi sẽ không tính tiền cho việc sửa máy giặt của bạn.  
Sincerely, Adam Pauline Customer Service Department.   Ký tên

questions.question: Business owners think TV commercials are an effective way to promote their products. What are the advantages and disadvantages of advertising on TV? Use specific reasons and examples to support your opinion.
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài A lot of companies these days want to advertise their products on TV, but it may not always be the right choice. Like many other types of advertisements, a TV advertisement has its own merits and demerits, especially taking into consideration the high cost involved in TV commercials. In my own opinion, there are many benefits to using TV as a method to promote products. Quảng cáo TV có các lợi ích và bất lợi, đặc biệt khi giá của quảng cáo rất cao. Theo quan điểm của tôi, có nhiều lợi ích khi quảng cáo qua TV.  
Thân bài 1 (Bất lợi: giá cả cao) Let's look at some of the downsides of using TV as an advertising medium. The first thing that anyone can easily guess is, in many cases, the hefty fees that broadcasting companies charge. In order to advertise during prime time TV shows, companies have to pay an unreasonably high fee to secure a minute or less. They pay astronomical sums of money for a brief appearance on TV. Especially when targeting a broad population using TV commercials can cost a lot of money. Some people just can't watch TV only when a certain type of commercial is aired since a TV commercial is repeated at some predefined time and those people do not have access to TV for whatever reason. - Phân tích: lệ phí khổng lồ cho việc quảng cáo trên TV. Để quảng cáo trong khung giờ vàng, công ty phải trả số tiền rất lớn để có được 1 phút hoặc ít hơn. Đặc biệt khi việc trọng tâm vào một thị trường rộn sẽ tốn rất nhiều tiền. Có vài người không thể xem được TV khi mà một loại quảng cáo cứ được chiếu.  
Thân bài 2 (Thoải mái nói hơn) Now, what are the upsides of TV commercials? TV is probably the most preferred advertisement method. Because of its effectiveness in creating a lasting impact on viewers and its endless ways of depicting products. With TV's distinctive features, advertisers can promote their products using both sound and sight. As psychologists say, when people use more of their sensory organs to detect an object, they tend to remember more of it, forming a lasting impact. Advertisers can take advantage of this fact to promote their products by using audio-visual devices. One such devices is TV, of course. In addition, TV advertising nowadays incorporates computer graphics technology and makes it possible to create absorbing motion pictures that we couldn't think of in the past. For example, we can now see laughing, crying, and even talking animals on TV. - Phân tích: nó rất hiệu quả trong việc tác động lâu dài tới người xem và rất nhiều cách để mô tả sản phẩm. Người quảng cáo có thể quảng bá sản phẩm bằng âm thanh và hình ảnh. Khi con người dùng mắt để biết về một vật, thường họ sẽ nhớ về nó hơn. Quảng cáo ngày này còn kết hợp với công nghệ máy tính và tạo ra các hình ảnh động mà chúng ta không thể nghĩ tới trong quá khứ
Kết bài As discussed above, mostly the high cost and the possibility of missing out on a chance to target a wide cross-section of the population are the drawbacks of TV advertising. However, the chance to make a lasting impact using TV's ability to show both sight and sound offers a lot to advertisers. Advertisers put more weight on these benefits and I agree with them. Tổng hợp luận điểm và nêu quan điểm cá nhân.

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
